# Reverse 1D Array

![Reverse 1D Array function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/array/14-reverse-1d-array.svg)

[Array functions](overview.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Reverses the element order of a one-dimensional array.

## Examples

These are real `.frog` documents from the same index used by Studio. Backend names and expected results describe the examples; they are not execution certificates.

- [Reverse exact I64 elements](../../examples/array.reverse.exact-i64.md) — The operation reverses immutable elements without a floating-point conversion. The value 9007199254740993 remains exact. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Reverse String elements without altering bytes](../../examples/array.reverse.strings-nul.md) — Array reversal changes element order only. The embedded NUL and UTF-8 bytes inside each String remain unchanged. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
